scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @agent-world/read-model && npm run dev --workspace @agent-world/web
scripts.format: biome format --write apps packages biome.json package.json tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.check.json vitest.config.ts
scripts.lint: biome check apps packages biome.json package.json tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.check.json vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: tsc -b && npm run test:e2e --workspace @agent-world/web && npm run test:e2e:production --workspace @agent-world/web
scripts.test:runtime: npm run build && npm run test:runtime:isolated --workspace @agent-world/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.check.json --noEmit && npm run build --workspace @agent-world/orchestration && npm run typecheck --workspace @agent-world/web
